nodes.title: Compliance deletion counts match what it marked
nodes.summary: The standing compliance deletion implementation, answered by a proof that its affected counts are the rows it marked deleted.

nodes.title: Proof that a compliance deletion's affected counts are the rows it marked deleted
nodes.summary: One test runs a compliance deletion over a fixture mixing target-only rows, a shared attribute and an already superseded chunk. It checks that affected is {chunks 1, fragments 1, links 2, attributes 3} and that those numbers equal the rows whose status turned to deleted.
